bio: Located in a still-central area of the city, this restaurant is not a new opening but has recently reinvented its identity by entrusting the kitchen to a Roman chef with a solid background. The culinary offering maintains a classic structure, with a choice between a “surprise” tasting menu and an extensive à la carte selection. In the kitchen, local and national traditions intertwine, enriched by an international touch that translates into visually striking, colorful creations that above all deliver on the palate. The dishes, both meat and fish, follow the seasonality of ingredients, with particular attention to vegetable pairings. Among the standout offerings: the pumpkin risotto with blue prawn, red berry umami, and Caesar salad crisp, a successful balance of technique, flavor, and creativity.
